analyst_view.overall: Early view: Castellón, second with the best defence in the division (five goals conceded in 12 games), have not played a league match since 1 November after asking to postpone their game with Eibar following the death of their former striker Jesús de Miguel. Valladolid have won two in a row, including their first away win of the season at Sporting, but Fran Escribá is without the injured Juanmi Latasa, Guille Bueno, De Rooij and Dani Pérez, and Iván Alejo is suspended after also limping off in Gijón.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals. I lean lower: Pablo Hernández's Castellón defend by keeping the ball and have let in five goals in 12 games, and Valladolid are without their striker Latasa and the suspended Alejo. Valladolid's last two games had seven and three goals, but against Leganés's weak defence and a Sporting side that had to chase the game.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.2 corners and I stay close to that. Castellón use the full width of the pitch and should have most of the ball, which adds corners at one end, but Valladolid are unlikely to win many at the other with their attack depleted. The two effects roughly cancel out.

cards.text: The numbers say 6.1 cards. I lean a little higher: LaLiga's own figures show Valladolid with 34 yellows and four reds against Castellón's 22 and two, and a home side chasing a possession team usually commits the fouls. The site also lists Castellón's Matías Orozco as banned after a red card, so the visitors are not spotless either.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.5 shots. I lean lower: Castellón's possession game limits what opponents get, and 12.6 home shots for Valladolid looks high with Latasa and Alejo missing. Castellón themselves were held to one goal and few clear chances at Burgos last time out.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.2 shots on target. I lean lower for the same reasons: a Castellón defence that has conceded five league goals all season, and a Valladolid attack missing its main striker. Castellón may also be short of sharpness after two weeks without a league game.
